title: Define V1 InitialProfile schema and question justification map
body:
Outcome: define the V1 intake data contract and prove every question drives score, quote, implementation path, profile, evidence guidance, or documents.

Data objects: InitialProfile, ReadinessScore, QuoteRecommendation.

Acceptance criteria:
- InitialProfile fields are documented.
- Each intake question has a justification.
- Fields that only belong after gap analysis are marked for ImplementationProfile.
- Example profiles exist for enclave, full tenant, GCC High, and readiness-only cases.

Verification:
- Review ROADMAP and docs/PROJECT_OPERATING_MODEL.md alignment.
- Add schema tests once implementation starts.

title: Build clean guided intake flow
body:
Outcome: create a simple guided form usable at a booth or by a customer online later.

Data objects: Customer, InitialProfile.

Acceptance criteria:
- Form captures only justified V1 questions.
- Customer-facing wording is clear and non-technical where possible.
- Internal user can complete the same flow with a lead at a booth.
- Review step shows all answers before save.
- Saved profile can be reopened.

Verification:
- Manual desktop check.
- Manual mobile-width check if UI is browser based.
- Screenshot attached to PR.

title: Implement deterministic readiness scoring
body:
Outcome: calculate a readiness score and confidence level from InitialProfile answers.

Data objects: InitialProfile, ReadinessScore.

Acceptance criteria:
- Score is deterministic for the same input.
- Missing or unknown answers affect confidence without creating a dead-end result.
- Scoring categories are documented.
- Tests cover representative customer profiles.

Verification:
- Automated tests for low, medium, and high readiness examples.

title: Implement RainTech quote and package recommendation logic
body:
Outcome: recommend package, quote range, and recurring option from InitialProfile.

Data objects: InitialProfile, QuoteRecommendation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Supports GCC enclave, full GCC tenant migration, GCC High enclave, full GCC High migration, controlled access, readiness-only, audit sprint, existing GCC hardening, and Level 1 starter.
- Supports vCISO plus ongoing compliance at $6,000/month.
- Unknowns lower confidence but still produce a recommendation.
- Pricing rules are centralized and testable.

Verification:
- Automated tests for each package.

title: Create V1 profile summary page
body:
Outcome: show score, recommended package, quote range, confidence, and next steps after intake.

Data objects: InitialProfile, ReadinessScore, QuoteRecommendation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Summary is easy to walk through with a lead.
- Quote range and recurring option are visible.
- Confidence and assumptions are visible.
- Internal action can convert profile to a customer workspace in V2.

Verification:
- Screenshot attached to PR.
- Manual smoke test using one enclave example and one full tenant example.

title: Create internal customer workspace shell
milestone: V2 - Internal Workspace and Gap Analysis
body:
Outcome: create the internal customer record where profile, quote, assessment, evidence, reports, and documents will live.

Data objects: Customer, InitialProfile, ImplementationProfile, GapAssessment.

Acceptance criteria:
- Customer list and customer detail exist.
- Customer detail shows profile summary, readiness/quote, assessment status, and next actions.
- Navigation is simple and does not resemble a generic dashboard blob.
- Workspace can be extended by V3-V5 without redesign.

Verification:
- Manual navigation check.
- Screenshot attached to PR.

title: Build CMMC Level 2 gap analysis workflow
milestone: V2 - Internal Workspace and Gap Analysis
body:
Outcome: allow RainTech to assess CMMC Level 2 objectives for a customer.

Data objects: GapAssessment, ControlObjectiveResult, POAMItem.

Acceptance criteria:
- Uses 14 domains, 110 requirements, and 320 objectives.
- Supports statuses such as not assessed, not met, partial, met/captured, and escalating.
- Supports notes, owner, due date, and POA&M flag.
- Objective navigation is fast and clear.

Verification:
- Automated seed count test.
- Manual update/status check.

title: Enrich ImplementationProfile from gap analysis
milestone: V2 - Internal Workspace and Gap Analysis
body:
Outcome: capture environment details discovered during gap analysis into the final implementation profile.

Data objects: ImplementationProfile, GapAssessment, ControlObjectiveResult.

Acceptance criteria:
- InitialProfile remains separate from ImplementationProfile.
- Gap analysis can update final profile fields such as tools, CUI flow, identity model, endpoint model, backup model, incident process, evidence maturity, and implementation exceptions.
- Final profile has a clear reviewed/approved state.

Verification:
- Tests or fixtures show InitialProfile -> ImplementationProfile progression.

title: Integrate evidence upload and evidence library
body:
Outcome: integrate manual evidence capture into the customer workspace.

Data objects: EvidenceItem, EvidenceMapping, ControlObjectiveResult.

Acceptance criteria:
- File picker upload works.
- Windows Explorer drag/drop upload works.
- Evidence metadata is captured without asking for data the system already knows.
- Evidence library is searchable.
- Evidence can be mapped to one or many objectives.

Verification:
- Manual drag/drop check.
- Automated mapping tests.

title: Implement evidence replace, delete, detach, and reuse behavior
body:
Outcome: preserve the important evidence lifecycle behavior from the existing tracker.

Data objects: EvidenceItem, EvidenceMapping, ControlObjectiveResult.

Acceptance criteria:
- Replace keeps objective mappings intact.
- Delete removes mappings and updates now-empty objective status correctly.
- Detach removes one mapping without deleting the evidence item.
- Reuse does not duplicate stored files unnecessarily.

Verification:
- Automated tests cover replace, delete, detach, and reuse.

title: Build SharePoint-ready evidence ZIP export
body:
Outcome: export objective-organized evidence packages for client or SharePoint use.

Data objects: EvidenceItem, EvidenceMapping, GapAssessment.

Acceptance criteria:
- ZIP contains objective-specific evidence copies.
- ZIP includes manifest.csv.
- Objective filenames remain predictable.
- Export does not break many-to-many evidence reuse.

Verification:
- Automated ZIP export test.
- Manual inspection of sample ZIP.

title: Generate readiness and gap reports
body:
Outcome: produce exportable reports that summarize profile, readiness, and gap analysis.

Data objects: InitialProfile, ImplementationProfile, ReadinessScore, GapAssessment.

Acceptance criteria:
- Readiness report uses V1 profile and score data.
- Gap report uses objective status and notes.
- Reports can be exported.
- Reports are linked to customer and assessment.

Verification:
- Generate reports for sample customer.
- Validate key counts and summary fields.

title: Generate POA&M and evidence capture reports
body:
Outcome: produce operational reports for remediation and evidence capture.

Data objects: POAMItem, EvidenceItem, EvidenceMapping, ControlObjectiveResult.

Acceptance criteria:
- POA&M/status report includes owner, due date, objective, status, and notes.
- Evidence capture report shows captured and missing evidence by objective/domain.
- Counts match assessment data.
- Reports are exportable.

Verification:
- Automated report count tests.
- Manual export check.

title: Create document template registry
body:
Outcome: manage RainTech-provided document templates before generating SSPs, policies, procedures, and diagrams.

Data objects: GeneratedDocument, ImplementationProfile.

Acceptance criteria:
- Templates are listed and versioned.
- Template placeholders are documented.
- Generated drafts remain editable before export.
- Template-bound AI assist is treated as optional support, not freeform replacement.

Verification:
- Add one sample template and generate a draft.

title: Generate SSP from final ImplementationProfile
body:
Outcome: generate SSP draft sections from the final implementation profile, assessment data, and evidence status.

Data objects: ImplementationProfile, GapAssessment, EvidenceItem, GeneratedDocument.

Acceptance criteria:
- SSP generation uses ImplementationProfile, not InitialProfile alone.
- Customer environment details populate the correct sections.
- Generated draft is editable and linked to customer.
- Export format is defined.

Verification:
- Generate SSP draft from sample completed gap analysis.

title: Design hosted platform security and RBAC
body:
Outcome: decide hosted architecture, authentication, RBAC, tenant separation, audit logging, backup, and file security model.

Acceptance criteria:
- Hosting model is documented.
- RBAC roles are defined.
- Customer tenant boundary model is defined.
- Evidence file storage/security model is defined.
- Migration from local-first storage is addressed.

Verification:
- ADR created for selected approach.

title: Design customer portal scope
body:
Outcome: define the first customer portal capabilities after hosted security foundations exist.

Acceptance criteria:
- Portal read/write boundaries are defined.
- Customer-visible reports are defined.
- Evidence request/upload behavior is defined.
- Internal approval/review behavior is defined.

Verification:
- ADR or product spec created.

title: Spike automated evidence sources
body:
Outcome: identify the first automation candidates and data requirements.

Acceptance criteria:
- Candidate sources include M365, Entra, Intune, Defender, Huntress, Autotask, and SharePoint.
- Each source lists authentication, permissions, evidence produced, control mappings, and risk.
- First automation target is recommended.

Verification:
- Spike notes committed under docs/.
